title: Does Wall Street Think Gemini 4 Argon Stacks Up Against The Competition?
summary: During a recent episode of The AI Investor Podcast, Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith broke down the recent release of Google's Gemini 4 Argon, and examined how it stacks up against the competition in areas such as coding. The duo also discussed what Wall Street appears to think about the release and what this could mean for the future of Alphabet's stock. With fierce competition from OpenAI as well as Anthropic's Muse, AI investors want to know which model will be able to separate itself from the pack in the coming years so that they can invest before it's too late.
